the use of LPG and electric burners in households will have positive environmental and health implications.

(i) the use of firewood for cooking is the major source of air pollution and greenhouse gas emission; (ii) there is a strong correlation between fuel use and household income, with the poor relying on firewood for cooking; (iii) the use of cleaner fuel (LPG) for cooking reduces the risk of respiratory illness and other health problems; (iv) LPG is more efficient than firewood in terms of fuel use and energy output.
